targetText: In What Sense We Can Speak of the International Significance of the Russian Revolution
explanation: Lenin argues that core lessons of the Russian Revolution have universal validity across international labor struggles, rather than being isolated to Russian conditions.

targetText: During those fifteen years, no other country knew anything even approximating to that revolutionary experience, that rapid and varied succession of different forms of the movement; legal and illegal, peaceful and stormy, underground and open, local circles and mass movements, and parliamentary and terrorist forms.
explanation: Boycotting parliamentary elections is only effective during active revolutionary uprisings; otherwise, parliament must be used as a public platform to educate workers.
